cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially funds-like asset, but only partially peelable under controlling-shareholder cash extraction view.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Current bank time deposits are funds assets, but maturity buckets and entity location are not split; group cash may sit in PRC/VIE schools and is affected by prepaid tuition and school development restrictions.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially peelable only after preserving school operations and service obligations.

cash_breakdown.reason: Included with heavy haircut rather than fully deducted.

cash_breakdown.item: Prepaid tuition and boarding service obligation reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Contract liabilities were RMB362.045m. Half is reserved as cash not realistically peelable because it backs future education and boarding services already paid for by students.
cash_breakdown.reason: Prepaid student fees are not equivalent to excess owner cash.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC earnings are not expected to be distributed in the foreseeable future per Note 7(d); cash extraction would face withholding tax, FX and governance friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Friction reserve before any controlling-shareholder extraction.

profit_quality.assessment: Operating cash conversion is good in the disclosed two-year window, but cash distributability is not the same as operating cash generation because the group is a PRC private education business controlled through structured contracts. 2024 had no proposed final dividend, and the annual report says undistributed PRC earnings are retained for expansion.
adjustments: Used RMB307.099m as pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit, anchored to the lower of 2023 and 2024 reported parent net profit rather than the stronger 2024 year.
Operating cash flow was RMB480.427m in 2024 and RMB391.373m in 2023; after disclosed capital expenditure, operating free cash flow was RMB386.757m and RMB239.433m.
Applied 0.55 profit haircut for PRC private education/VIE distribution limits, school development fund requirements, continuing campus funding and absent 2024 dividend proposal.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 operating cash flow / parent net profit was about 1.45x; 2023 was about 1.27x. Cash flow supports accounting profit, but not full shareholder-level distributability.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Strong operating cash conversion offset by VIE/private school cash extraction limits and expansion-retention policy.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: 2024 disclosed capital expenditures were RMB93.7m, mainly buildings, school facilities, equipment and software; treated as already reflected in the pre-haircut sustainable cash anchor.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital released cash through higher contract liabilities and other payables; this is not assumed to be permanently distributable.
